Modem signals use isolated MCU_* nets until translator is selected.
No direct 3V3 connection to unknown modem IO voltage.
No touch controller allocated in this revision.
PICO integrates RF matching; external pi network is tuning provision per official peripheral schematic, not a guessed chip match.
No boot button on enclosure. ESP_BOOT and ESP_EN go to fixture test points. Do not pull GPIO45 high.

06 / AUDIO - ES8311 codec, analog MEMS input and PAM8302A speaker driver
EVT-V1 / REVIEW DRAFT / NOT FOR FABRICATION / FOOTPRINTS & ERC PENDING
TBD / NO PHYSICAL PIN NUMBERS / NO FOOTPRINT
TBD / NO PHYSICAL PIN NUMBERS / NO FOOTPRINT
ES8311 Rev 5.0 recommended supply: DVDD/PVDD 1.6-3.6 V, AVDD 1.7-3.6 V, absolute max 3.6 V; hold +3V3_SYS inside 3.0-3.6 V or the codec keeps no headroom.
ES8311 Rev 5.0 documents no mic bias or electret supply pin; the MIC1N reference and the mic bias network stay TBD with the microphone selection.
Codec I2C address is 0011 00x, CE strapped low gives 0x18; no clash with BMI270 0x68, RV-3028-C7 0x51/0x52, MAX17048 0x36 or DRV2605L 0x5A.
ES8311 in slave mode expects externally supplied SCLK/LRCK; in master mode both derive from MCLK. Clock direction and ESP32 I2S feasibility remain unvalidated.
PAM8302A delivers 0.72 W min / 0.80 W typ into 8 ohm at VDD=3.6 V and 10% THD+N; 1 W from a 3.3 V rail is not achievable. A 1 W speaker rating is not delivered power.
Amp VDD drafted on VBAT (2.0-5.5 V allowed, SHDN must stay within VDD+0.3 V); +3V3_SYS and SYS stay open options - confirm cell impedance and peak current with the pack data.
SHDN releases through R601/C614 for a datasheet 1-100 ms delay after VBAT rises; no spare GPIO exists for explicit enable control.
One 220 nF cap per side merges the ES8311 output coupling with the PAM8302A CI 0.1-0.22 uF requirement; corner against the internal 10 k is about 72 Hz.
Filterless BTL: never reference SPK_P or SPK_N to ground, keep the pair short, and add the datasheet ferrite-bead filter when the runs exceed 20 cm.
ES8311 typical circuit separates GND(SYS) from AGND with 0 ohm; one GND net is kept until the PCB ground-strategy decision is taken.
Footprints, the ES8311 QFN-20 land pattern and the acoustic assembly are still not released.

ES8311 Rev 5.0 package drawing shows an unnumbered exposed die-attach pad and the typical circuit labels that pad 21/PGND, while the pin table lists only 1-20; U9 keeps 20 pins until the vendor release confirms the pad and its net.

PAM8302A gain is fixed by the internal 150k/10k pair at 23.5 dB. The ES8311 full-scale output is 0.4535 Vrms, so the amp clips before full codec volume; trim with the DAC volume register or add an external RIN of about 16k ohm once the acoustic target is set.

分区备注 CJK 电源与充电 未选型 D01
分区备注：电源与充电 / 未选型 D01
VBUS_5V → BQ24074(U6) → SYS 供电路径管理
SYS → TPS63070(U7) → +3V3_SYS 升降压；MAX17048(U5) 电量计 + NTC
VBAT 直供 4G 模组：该路径待复核；+1V8 为可选轨
布板要求：置于表体中心、完整地
SPI TFT 240×280 / 1.69 英寸：LCD_SCLK / MOSI / CS / DC
FPC 连接器、LED 驱动与触摸均未定
ES8311(U9) + 模拟 MEMS 麦 + PAM8302A(U10)；喇叭为差分 BTL 输出
编解码手册目前是第三方镜像版（仅限内部评审）；声学待定
AIoT 老人看护手表 · 硬件单页总图
工程 aiot-kicad-import（嘉立创EDA专业版） 页 10_ALL 合并阅读视图 版本 EVT-V1 REVIEW DRAFT 2026-09-21
内容来自 hardware/kicad 的 KiCad 工程导入 位号 126 本页网络 102 同名网络已在页内自动相连
发布闸门 HOLD：未布板、不出 Gerber —— NOT FOR FABRICATION
未选型：12 个器件 无引脚/无厂牌、19 项 仅待定值，见 JLC_PART_MAP.csv
连通性闸门 tools/check_sch_netlist_parity.py --page 10_ALL，证据 build/sch_netlist_parity_10_ALL.txt
本页位号已全部排除出 BOM 与 PCB 转交，网表与 BOM 只取 00–08 九个源页
图例：琥珀色框 = 功能分区（00–08 各一块），该区的备注写在框内下方
版面按信号流排布：上排 电源 → 主控 → 显示，中排 4G 模组 / 音频 / IMU·RTC，下排 触觉按键 / 调试 / 索引
本页把九张功能页整块搬来（块内几何未动），不是逐器件重新走线的真·重排
符号↔封装的绑定状态与每块未定项：见 hardware/jlc/README.md
U2 SIM8230C 未选型 → 符号无引脚，它的连接不在这张图上
本页为 00–08 九页合并出的阅读视图
网表与 BOM 只从九个源页取，本页器件全部排除
发布闸门 HOLD：未布板、不产出 Gerber；缺手册的器件仍阻塞评审
对外总线：I2C / SPI / I2S0 / PCM / UART；USB + BOOT + RESET 烧录夹具
GPIO 控制余量紧张：尚有 3 个网络未定
U2 = SIM8230C 未选型 → 符号无引脚，网表不含其连接
Nano SIM 卡座 + eSIM 选项；MAIN / DIV / GNSS 三路天线 + Wi-Fi RF
UART / PCM 电平转换待定；HDG 引脚映射与焊盘被阻塞
DRV2605L(U11) → LRA 或 ERM 马达
4-pin pogo 触点：5V / GND / TX / RX；ESP USB 与 MODEM USB 引出
底部 21 个命名测试盘
